lifecycle_gaps_retained: First-effective end date of EO 11460 not asserted (signed 1977-05-04, 'hereby revoked'; FR publication 1977-05-06).
notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: I re-hashed the held FR text (sha 3afba71a...) and read the full order: EO 11460 (34 FR 5535, signed 1969-03-20) establishes the President's Foreign Intelligence Advisory Board with continuing functions (sec. 1), information access (2), appointment of members (3), staff (4), funding from subsequent appropriations (5) and revokes EO 10938 (6). It has no expiry. I read the full held EO 11984 (42 FR 23129, 1977-05-04): 'in order to abolish the President's Foreign Intelligence Advisory Board, Executive Order No. 11460 of March 20, 1969, is hereby revoked', with no exception, qualifier, delayed date or savings clause, so the whole order is revoked and the 1989 'Revoked by EO 11984' row is only corroboration. Identity matches (number, date, board, 34 FR 5535). Earlier endings: cruden shows EO 11905 (1976) saying the board 'remains in effect' and EO 11985 deleting that sentence and a reference; neither ends or continues EO 11460, and 11985's deletion removed a statement only; its own text cites 11460 only as a deleted cross-reference. Section 6's revocation of EO 10938 is a performed one-time command and does not revive on 11984. I assert no effective date: the held text says 'hereby revoked' and is signed 1977-05-04, but signing is not an accepted effective date. Not decided here: the lifecycle date, residual acts or board members' appointments.
